story.coreAction: Tap to keep the saucer airborne and steer its height through each gate.
story.tension: Moving patterns, twin gates, and charged crystal shards make later encounters surprising.
story.payoff: Long runs carry the saucer through five visually distinct environments.
story.goal: Accelerate through an endless run and beat the saved high score.

research.title: Flappy Dunk
research.exactPhrase: Tap and bounce to a high score
research.takeaway: Lead with the one-tap verb and show the scoring obstacle in active play.

research.title: Helix Jump
research.exactPhrase: Reach the bottom of the tower!
research.takeaway: Use one clear spatial goal and keep the hazard structure visually dominant.

research.title: Crossy Road
research.takeaway: Let a distinctive low-poly world and a readable player silhouette carry the promise.

research.title: Stack
research.takeaway: Keep the copy compact and the core obstacle pattern immediately legible.

research.title: Tiny Wings
research.takeaway: Pair a simple one-touch flight fantasy with a vivid, welcoming landscape.
